notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.content:
Fixes

     Fix Credits text not displaying icons in Portuguse Locale

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 - Adds Portuguse (Brasil) localization
notes.content:
Updates

     Portuguese Brazil Localization available
     Anchors in map swapped places to make keyboard navigation easier
     Adds ability to remove key/control bindings



Fixes

     Prevent duplicate bindings when re-assigning keys
     Prevent displaying a yellow question mark when an icon for a key does not exist
     Localization/Difficulty carousels properly display when there’s more options to the left or right

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
Fixes

     Resolve lines showing up between tiles on higher resolutions

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Updates


 French localization available in game
 Global Leaderboards should now display top 5 as well as some scores around the user, you may see the board refresh when these new scores are downloaded


Fixes

 Credits achievement should now unlock when you break the last name without having to exit through the anchor
 Prevent leaderboard uploads crashing all leaderboard system (at least one instance of it)

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
Potential fix for Credits Achievement not unlocking
 Cartographer’s Cove: Fixed an eel doing damage through a wall
 WIP: Integrating FR locale, not ready for use just yet.
 Potential fix for leaderboards scrolling to bottom when data loaded.
 Fix locale selection not marking component as selected.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - More Crab bug fixes
notes.content: - Fixes another issue where a crab stealing a chest could lead to your currently held chest bugging out, primarily manifests itself on Shipwrecks 6 since there's multiple chests and many more crabs.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
- Fixes an issue where the crabs don't release the chest fully and its no longer interactable
- Fixes a broken minimap on Pirate Shipwrecks 5


More fixes will come soon!
